newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FLAT AFTER THIN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FLAT AFTER THIN TRADE.

text.p: The Bulgaria lev closed around 216.80-217.50 per dollar, little changed from 217.20/70 in the morning, after calm and thin interbank forex trade, dealers said.
"Today's trade was limited in servicing final clients," a commercial bank dealer said, adding that the bulk of today's deals were with tomorrow's value date.
Higher foreign currency demand pressed the lev to 218.00/50 per dollar at noon but dollar sales by the central bank covered the demand and boosted the lev to around 217 levs per dollar, traders said.
According to other dealers the central bank has only bought small dollar volumes.
